newsitem.title: USA: Solar-Mates to buy Serengeti Eyewear.
newsitem.headline: Solar-Mates to buy Serengeti Eyewear.

text.p: Solar-Mates Inc said on Tuesday that it has signed a contract to purchase Corning Inc's Serengeti Eyewear business for $27.5 million.

Solar-Mates Chairman Stephen Nevitt said in a telephone interview that the company is raising $22.5 million through a private equity investment to put toward the purchase. The rest, he said, will be raised through bank debt.
The companies said they expect the sale will be completed in the fourth quarter or early in 1997.
